g.title: XIAO
g.text: Edge header carries 3V3, two GND pads, 5V, plus GPIO 1..9 / 43 / 44.
GPIO 10..37 are back-side castellated pads — solder from underneath.

g.title: W_RFID
g.text: SPI2 + RST + IRQ + 3V3 power to MFRC522.

g.title: W_SD
g.text: SPI3 + card-detect + 3V3 power to microSD breakout.

g.title: W_LED
g.text: Each colour wire passes through a 220 Ω resistor before the LED anode.

g.title: AMP
g.text: VIN = 3V3 (single-rail, battery friendly). GAIN floating = +9 dB.
SD must be driven low before DEEP_SLEEP to avoid ~3 mA idle draw.

g.title: RFID
g.text: 3.3 V module only — never wire VCC to 5V.

g.title: SD
g.text: VCC = 3V3. CD switches to GND when a card is seated; firmware
reads it with an internal pull-up.

g.title: LED
g.text: One 220 Ω resistor in series with each colour anode.
